([[Norcross, Georgia]]) | college = [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont]] (2019–2023) | draft_year = 2023 | draft_round = 1 | draft_pick = 26 | draft_team = [[Indiana Pacers]] | career_start = 2023 | years1 = {{nbay|2023|start}}–present | team1 = [[Indiana Pacers]] | years2 = [[2023–24 NBA G League season|2023–2024]] | team2 = →[[Indiana Mad Ants]] | highlights = * First-team All-[[Missouri Valley Conference|MVC]] (2023) * First-team All-[[Ohio Valley Conference|OVC]] (2022) }} '''Benjamin Lee Sheppard''' (born July 16, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Indiana Pacers]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont Bruins]] before being selected by the Pacers in the first round of the [[2023 NBA draft]]. ==Early life and high school career== Sheppard grew up in [[Atlanta]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] and attended [[Greater Atlanta Christian School]] (GAC).{{cite web|url=https://www.gwinnettdailypost.com/sports/greater-atlanta-christian-grad-ben-sheppard-earns-nba-combine-invitation/article_60887004-e910-11ed-af2c-1f4b00ee9f8b.html|title=Greater Atlanta Christian grad Ben Sheppard earns NBA Combine invitation|work=[[Gwinnett Daily Post]]|date=May 2, 2023|access-date=May 17, 2023}} He averaged 13.7 points per game during his junior season as GAC won the Class AAA State Championship.{{cite web |date=September 15, 2018 |title=GAC's Ben Sheppard commits to Belmont for basketball |url=https://www.gwinnettprepsports.com/sports/gac-s-ben-sheppard-commits-to-belmont-for-basketball/article_d8099fd2-7235-5c68-a233-25640764a9a8.html |access-date=May 19, 2023 |website=GwinnettPrepSports.com |archive-date=May 19, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230519201652/https://www.gwinnettprepsports.com/sports/gac-s-ben-sheppard-commits-to-belmont-for-basketball/article_d8099fd2-7235-5c68-a233-25640764a9a8.html |url-status=dead }} ==College career== Sheppard played in 32 games averaging 2.9 points during his freshman season at Belmont. He became a starter going into his sophomore year and averaged 10.5 points on the year.{{cite web|url=https://www.belmontvision.com/post/ben-sheppard-is-belmont-basketball-s-strong-and-silent-superstar|title=Ben Sheppard is Belmont basketball's strong and silent superstar|first=Landen|last=Secrest|website=BelmontVision.com|date=February 23, 2022|access-date=May 17, 2023}} Sheppard was named first team All-[[Ohio Valley Conference]] as a junior after averaging 16.2 points per game.{{cite web |last=Awtrey |first=Stan |date=November 28, 2022 |title=Greater Atlanta Christian grad Ben Sheppard shows off game in Belmont's win at Georgia State |url=https://www.gwinnettdailypost.com/sports/greater-atlanta-christian-grad-ben-sheppard-shows-off-game-in-belmonts-win-at-georgia-state/article_46bb73d4-6f8e-11ed-9d4c-afec14049f54.html |access-date=May 17, 2023 |work=[[Gwinnett Daily Post]]}} He was named first team All-[[Missouri Valley Conference]], to which the Bruins had moved, as a senior after averaging 18.8 points per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.blazersedge.com/2023/5/10/23718793/portland-trail-blazers-draft-workouts-2023-trey-alexander-sheppard-hodge-miller-mitchell-phillips|title=Trail Blazers Work Out 6 NBA Draft Prospects Today|first=Joe|last=Moore|website=BlazersEdge.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=May 10, 2023|access-date=May 17, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/nba-draft-combine-6-standouts-who-helped-their-draft-stock-the-most-203839494.html|title=NBA Draft Combine: 6 standouts who helped their draft stock the most|first=Krysten|last=Peek|website=[[Yahoo Sports]]|date=May 19, 2023|access-date=May 19, 2023}} ==Professional career== The [[Indiana Pacers]] selected Sheppard in the first round with the 26th overall pick in the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{cite web |date=June 22, 2023 |title='He's a multiple-effort guy': Pacers select Ben Sheppard with 26th pick in NBA Draft |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/nba/pacers/2023/06/22/pacers-select-ben-sheppard-with-26th-pick-in-nba-draft/70345982007/ |url-access=subscription |access-date=June 23, 2023 |work=[[Indianapolis Star]]}} On July 1, 2023, Sheppard signed his rookie contract with the Pacers alongside the 8th overall pick [[Jarace Walker]].{{cite news |last=Hill |first=Arthur |date=July 1, 2023 |title=Pacers Sign Jarace Walker, Ben Sheppard |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/07/pacers-sign-jarace-walker-ben-sheppard.html |access-date=July 1, 2023 |agency=HoopsRumors.com}} ==Career
